title: Find the shelf number
scenario: These shelf numbers are sorted smallest to biggest. Find where 12 sits — without scanning them one by one.

intro.job: These shelf numbers are sorted smallest to biggest. Find where 12 sits — without scanning them one by one.

idea.rule: Check the last shelf standing — the search runs while lo is still at or below hi, not just below.
idea.detail: Binary search keeps two fingers, lo and hi, around the part of the list that could still hold the target. Look at the middle: too small means the target is to the right (lo = mid + 1), too big means it's to the left (hi = mid - 1). Each look halves what's left. When lo and hi land on the same shelf, that shelf still needs checking — so the loop runs while lo <= hi.

watch.code:
nums, target = pair
lo = 0
hi = len(nums) - 1
found = -1
while lo <= hi:
    mid = (lo + hi) // 2
    if nums[mid] == target:
        found = mid
        break
    elif nums[mid] < target:
        lo = mid + 1
    else:
        hi = mid - 1
print(found)

model_restatement: Find the position of the target in the sorted list by halving, and print it — or -1 if it isn't there.

clarify.question: What if the target isn't on any shelf?
Can a number appear twice?
clarify.answer: No — every shelf number is different.

clarify.question: Can I just scan from the front?
clarify.answer: It would work — but the job is to halve, not scan.

clarify_fallback: Good question — assume the simple case.
blueprint: Keep lo and hi around the search area. While lo is below hi, look at the middle and move lo or hi toward the target. Print where you found it, or -1.

why_line: After two looks, lo and hi both sit on shelf 5 — but 'while lo < hi' is already False, so shelf 5 (the 12) is never checked and found stays -1.

explain.rule: lo < hi stops the search when exactly ONE shelf is left — the very shelf that might hold the answer — so the last shelf standing never gets looked at.
explain.bridge: When lo and hi point at the same shelf, should the search stop or look?

fix.rule: while lo <= hi: keep looking while there's at least one shelf left, including the last one.

walk.gloss: Keep going while there's at least one shelf in range — even just one.
Too small — the target is to the right, so drop everything up to mid.
